result.brief: 提出分离 RGB 与掩码 token 流的扩散视频抠像框架，并用 preserve/refine 可学习 token 实现跨分块滑窗推理与长视频时序一致。
result.reason: Diffusion video matting with separate RGB/mask token streams, learnable preserve/refine tokens and sliding-window long-video inference; token-level conditioning and temporal consistency transfer to video generation latents.
